grammar: n. 虾。可说 a shrimp；复数常用 shrimp，也可用 shrimps。菜单中 shrimp 常泛指虾肉。
collocations: fresh shrimp; peel shrimp; shrimp soup; a shrimp dish
commonMistake: shrimp 的复数可以仍写 shrimp；若强调一只只虾，也可写 shrimps。不要把它误写成动词过去式。

example.english: We bought fresh shrimp at the market and made soup for lunch.
example.chinese: 我们在市场买了新鲜的虾，中午做了汤。

application.prompt: The seafood restaurant serves fresh ___ with rice. A. shrimp B. lamb
application.solution: A。解析：和米饭搭配供应的海鲜是 shrimp（虾）；lamb 指羊肉。

grammar: v. 爆裂；突然迸发；n. 爆发；一阵。过去式和过去分词都为 burst；常接 into tears/laughter。
collocations: a burst of laughter; burst into tears; burst out laughing; burst a balloon
commonMistake: burst 是不规则变化，三种形式都写 burst；不要按规则动词写成 bursted。

example.english: The balloon burst when the little boy touched it with a pin.
example.chinese: 小男孩用针碰了一下气球，气球就爆了。

application.prompt: The balloon ___ as soon as it touched the sharp branch. A. shook B. burst
application.solution: B。解析：气球碰到尖树枝后“爆裂”，过去式仍是 burst。

grammar: n. 一笔；一画。可数名词，复数 brushstrokes；由 brush + stroke 构成。
collocations: a careful brushstroke; broad brushstrokes; a brushstroke of colour
commonMistake: brushstroke 指画笔留下的一笔，写复数时只在词尾加 -s；不要把它当成画笔 brush 本身。

example.english: Each brushstroke in the painting adds movement to the river.
example.chinese: 这幅画里的每一笔都让河水显得更有动感。

application.prompt: The artist added one final ___ to the sky with a thin brush. A. brushstroke B. brush
application.solution: A。解析：画家用细画笔在天空部分添上最后“一笔”，应填 brushstroke。

grammar: adj. 生动逼真的。常作定语，也可作表语；由 life 与 like 构成，比较级可用 more lifelike。
collocations: a lifelike painting; lifelike details; look lifelike
commonMistake: lifelike 形容外观“像真的”，不是说对象真的活着；描述雕像时用 lifelike statue，而非 living statue。

example.english: The lifelike wax figure looked just like the famous singer.
example.chinese: 这尊栩栩如生的蜡像看起来和那位著名歌手一模一样。

application.prompt: The artist added ___ details that made the face look real. A. live B. lifelike
application.solution: B。解析：能让面孔看起来像真人的细节是 lifelike（逼真的）；live 表示活着的或现场的。

grammar: v.（使）结合、组合。可作及物或不及物动词；combine A and B / combine A with B；combine to do sth。
collocations: combine two ideas; combine A with B; combine to form; combine work and study
commonMistake: 表达“把 A 与 B 结合”时用 combine A with B 或 combine A and B；不要在 combine 后直接接 with A and B。

example.english: The recipe combines fresh fruit with plain yogurt.
example.chinese: 这份食谱把新鲜水果和原味酸奶搭配在一起。

application.prompt: To make the cake, ___ the flour, milk, and eggs in one bowl. A. combine B. compare
application.solution: A。解析：把几种原料放在一起是 combine（混合）；compare 是比较。

grammar: 短语：combine A with B，把 A 与 B 结合起来。A、B 通常是名词、代词或动名词。
collocations: combine study with exercise; combine tradition with modern design; combine A with B
commonMistake: 此结构中 combine 后先放 A，再用 with 引出 B；不能写成 combine with A with B。

example.english: The designer combined traditional patterns with modern colours.
example.chinese: 设计师把传统图案和现代色彩结合起来。

application.prompt: She wants to ___ Chinese ink painting ___ modern design. A. separate; from B. combine; with
application.solution: B。解析：句意是“把中国水墨画与现代设计结合”；固定结构为 combine A with B。

grammar: adj. 截然相反的；在对面的；n. 对立面。常用 the opposite of；表示“在……对面”可说 opposite the bank。
collocations: the opposite direction; opposite opinions; the opposite of; sit opposite someone
commonMistake: opposite 作介词表示“在……对面”时，后面通常直接接名词：opposite the station；不要机械加 to。

example.english: Their opinions were opposite, so they chose different plans.
example.chinese: 他们的意见截然相反，因此选择了不同的方案。

application.prompt: Their answers are ___: one says yes, while the other says no. A. opposite B. polite
application.solution: A。解析：一个答“是”、另一个答“否”，两人的答案正好相反，即 opposite。

grammar: n. 场景；情景；（戏剧中的）一场。可数，复数 scenes；scenery 通常作不可数名词，表示自然风景。
collocations: the final scene; a scene from a film; a street scene; scene of an accident
commonMistake: scene 是某个具体场景，可数；scenery 指总体风景，通常不可数。不要说 a scenery。

example.english: The final scene of the play takes place in a quiet garden.
example.chinese: 这部戏的最后一幕发生在一个安静的花园里。

application.prompt: The last ___ of the play takes place in a hospital. A. scenery B. scene
application.solution: B。解析：戏剧中可数的一幕是 a scene；scenery 通常指自然风景且不可数。

grammar: adj. 空的；v. 倒空。作动词时可接容器或物品作宾语：empty the box；过去式 emptied。
collocations: an empty room; an empty bottle; empty the bin; empty out a drawer
commonMistake: empty 作动词时表示“把……倒空”，宾语是被倒空的容器；过去式去 y 加 -ied：emptied。

example.english: Please empty the box before you fold it flat.
example.chinese: 请先把盒子倒空，再把它压平。

application.prompt: The bin is full, so please ___ it before adding more paper. A. empty B. fill
application.solution: A。解析：垃圾箱已经满了，添纸前应先把它倒空，故用 empty。

grammar: 短语：cover sth in sth，用某物覆盖某物；也可说 cover sth with sth。被动形式为 be covered in/with。
collocations: cover the furniture in plastic; cover a table with a cloth; be covered in snow
commonMistake: cover 后直接接被覆盖的对象，再用 in 引出覆盖物；被动句需写 be covered in，不能漏掉 be。

example.english: They covered the old chairs in clear plastic before painting the room.
example.chinese: 粉刷房间前，他们用透明塑料把旧椅子包了起来。

application.prompt: Before painting, we covered the furniture ___ plastic sheets. A. on B. in
application.solution: B。解析：家具被塑料覆盖，用 cover the furniture in plastic sheets；on 不符合该搭配。

grammar: adv. 完美地；完全地。由形容词 perfect 加 -ly 构成，常修饰动词或形容词。
collocations: work perfectly; fit perfectly; perfectly clear; perfectly safe
commonMistake: 动词 fit、work 等需要副词修饰时用 perfectly；perfect 是形容词，不能直接说 fits perfect。

example.english: The key fits perfectly, so the lock opens without force.
example.chinese: 这把钥匙完全合适，因此不用费力就能打开锁。

application.prompt: The key fits ___ into the lock, and the door opens at once. A. perfectly B. perfect
application.solution: A。解析：修饰动词 fits 要用副词 perfectly，表示“完全合适地”。

grammar: n. 美丽；美人；优点。常用 the beauty of；形容词为 beautiful，副词为 beautifully。
collocations: natural beauty; the beauty of nature; a beauty spot; beauty products
commonMistake: beauty 是名词，beautiful 才能直接修饰名词；可说 the beauty of the lake 或 a beautiful lake。

example.english: The beauty of the old bridge becomes clear at sunset.
example.chinese: 夕阳下，这座古桥的美展现得格外明显。

application.prompt: The old bridge has a quiet ___ of its own. A. beautiful B. beauty
application.solution: B。解析：a 后需要名词；beauty 表示“美”，beautiful 是形容词。

grammar: n. 雕塑家。指创作雕塑的人；作品是 sculpture（雕塑），可数时也可说 a sculpture。
collocations: a famous sculptor; a stone sculptor; sculptor and painter; work as a sculptor
commonMistake: sculptor 指创作者，sculpture 指作品或雕塑艺术；描述“雕塑家制作作品”时不要把两者互换。

example.english: The sculptor shaped the stone with a small hammer and chisel.
example.chinese: 这位雕塑家用小锤子和凿子雕刻石头。

application.prompt: The ___ used a hammer and chisel to shape the stone. A. sculptor B. sculpture
application.solution: A。解析：使用工具创作的人是 sculptor（雕塑家）；sculpture 是作品或雕塑艺术。

grammar: n. 皮肤；外皮。多作不可数名词；表示动物皮或特定的一层皮时也可数。动词 skin 表示剥皮。
collocations: dry skin; protect your skin; skin a potato; skin colour
commonMistake: 谈人的皮肤通常用不可数 skin；表示某人的皮肤时说 his skin，不在前面加 a。

example.english: Wear a hat to protect your skin from the strong sun.
example.chinese: 戴上帽子，保护皮肤免受强烈阳光照射。

application.prompt: Use sunscreen to protect your ___ from strong sunlight. A. skinned B. skin
application.solution: B。解析：protect your 后需接名词，skin 指皮肤；skinned 是形容词或动词过去分词。

grammar: n. 实验室，是 laboratory 的常用缩写。可数名词，复数 labs；常见于口语和校园语境。
collocations: a science lab; a computer lab; work in the lab; lab equipment
commonMistake: lab 是 laboratory 的缩写，适合日常语境；正式说明文中可首次写 laboratory，后文再用 lab。

example.english: The samples were kept in the school lab overnight.
example.chinese: 这些样本在学校实验室里存放了一夜。

application.prompt: The samples were kept in the science ___ overnight. A. lab B. library
application.solution: A。解析：存放实验样本的科学场所是 lab（实验室），不是 library（图书馆）。

grammar: n. 日常饮食；规定饮食；v. 节食。表示饮食结构常用 a healthy/balanced diet；diet 作节食动词时过去式 dieted。
collocations: a balanced diet; a healthy diet; diet and exercise; go on a diet
commonMistake: diet 不只表示为减重而节食，也可指日常饮食；说“均衡饮食”用 a balanced diet，而非 balance diet。

example.english: A balanced diet gives teenagers energy for study and sport.
example.chinese: 均衡的饮食能为青少年的学习和运动提供能量。

application.prompt: A balanced ___ includes vegetables, fruit, and enough protein. A. dieted B. diet
application.solution: B。解析：balanced 后需用名词 diet，指均衡饮食；dieted 是动词过去式。

grammar: 短语：be on a diet，正在节食或遵循特定饮食；go on a diet 表示开始节食。
collocations: be on a diet; go on a diet; put someone on a diet; a low-salt diet
commonMistake: 固定搭配用 on a diet，不用 in a diet；开始节食说 go on a diet。

example.english: Nina is on a diet, so she chose fruit instead of cake.
example.chinese: 妮娜正在节食，所以她选了水果而不是蛋糕。

application.prompt: Since the race is next month, Leo is ___ and choosing smaller portions. A. on a diet B. in a diet
application.solution: A。解析：表示“正在节食”用 be on a diet；in a diet 不是这个固定搭配。

grammar: v. 敲；撞；n. 敲击声。敲门常说 knock on/at the door；knock 的过去式和过去分词为 knocked。
collocations: knock on the door; knock at the window; knock over a cup; a loud knock
commonMistake: 表示敲门可用 knock on 或 knock at；表示“把东西撞倒”则用 knock over，不能省掉 over。

example.english: Please knock on the door before you enter the office.
example.chinese: 进办公室前请先敲门。

application.prompt: Please ___ on the door before you enter the office. A. smile B. knock
application.solution: B。解析：进入办公室前要“敲门”，搭配为 knock on the door。

grammar: n. 模型；模特；v. 示范；以……为原型。作动词时过去式 modeled/modelled；model A on B 表示以 B 为 A 的原型。
collocations: a model plane; a role model; a fashion model; model a design on nature
commonMistake: model 作“模特”或“模型”时是名词；作动词表示示范或仿照，注意 model on 的介词 on。

example.english: Our class built a model of the solar system from coloured balls.
example.chinese: 我们班用彩色球制作了一个太阳系模型。

application.prompt: In science class, we built a ___ of the solar system with balls and wire. A. model B. mode
application.solution: A。解析：用球和金属丝制作的太阳系“模型”是 a model；mode 指方式或模式。

grammar: n. 瓷；瓷器，通常作不可数名词。具体器物可说 a piece of porcelain 或 a porcelain cup；porcelain 也可作定语。
collocations: blue-and-white porcelain; porcelain vase; porcelain figures; a piece of porcelain
commonMistake: porcelain 表示材料或瓷器时通常不可数；可说 a porcelain bowl，不说 a porcelain 来表示一件瓷器。

example.english: The museum displays porcelain made during the Ming dynasty.
example.chinese: 博物馆展出了明代制作的瓷器。

application.prompt: This cup is made of ___, so handle it carefully. A. plastic B. porcelain
application.solution: B。解析：需要小心拿放的精致瓷杯由 porcelain（瓷）制成。

examTags: 词汇·形容词与副词派生
grammar: adj. 稀有的；罕见的。副词 rarely 表示“很少”；a rare bird 中 rare 修饰名词。
collocations: a rare species; a rare chance; rare books; it is rare for someone to do sth
commonMistake: rare 描述某事物罕见，rarely 才修饰动词表示“很少”；不要说 I rare go there。

example.english: It is rare to see snow here in July.
example.chinese: 这里七月下雪很罕见。

application.prompt: It is ___ to see snow here in July; it happens only once in many years. A. rare B. regular
application.solution: A。解析：多年才发生一次说明七月下雪很“罕见”，应用 rare。

grammar: adv. 通常；一般地；普遍地。由 common + -ly 构成，常置于实义动词前或 be 动词后。
collocations: commonly used; commonly known as; commonly found; commonly seen
commonMistake: be commonly found 中 commonly 是副词，修饰 found；若放在名词前修饰名词，应改用 common。

example.english: This kind of shell is commonly found along the coast.
example.chinese: 这种贝壳在沿海地区很常见。

application.prompt: This plant is ___ found near rivers, not in dry deserts. A. common B. commonly
application.solution: B。解析：修饰 found 这一动作要用副词 commonly，表示“通常能发现”。

examTags: 词汇·专有名词与普通名词
grammar: n. 瓷；瓷器，常作不可数名词。小写 china 指瓷器；大写 China 指中国。
collocations: blue-and-white china; china plates; a china cup; fine china
commonMistake: 国家名 China 首字母必须大写；表示瓷器的 china 用小写，且通常不可数。

example.english: The shop window was filled with blue-and-white china.
example.chinese: 商店橱窗里摆满了青花瓷器。

application.prompt: The delicate bowl in this case is a piece of blue-and-white ___. A. iron B. china
application.solution: B。解析：精致的青花瓷碗由 china（瓷器）制成；iron（铁）不符合器物材料。

grammar: adj. 美术的；艺术的；有艺术天赋的。名词 artist 指艺术家，artistry 指艺术技巧。
collocations: artistic talent; artistic style; artistic design; an artistic person
commonMistake: artistic 是形容词，可修饰 style、talent 等名词；artist 是“艺术家”，不能直接说 an artist design。

example.english: The poster's artistic design won first prize at the school show.
example.chinese: 这张海报的艺术设计在学校展览中获得了一等奖。

application.prompt: The poster's ___ design won first prize. A. artist B. artistic
application.solution: B。解析：修饰名词 design 需要形容词 artistic；artist 是指人的名词。

grammar: 短语：on show，在展出、供公众观看。be on show 常与作品、展品作主语；也可说 on display。
collocations: be on show; put something on show; an exhibition on show; paintings on show
commonMistake: 表示展品正在展出用 on show；不要按中文“在展览中”直译为 in show。

example.english: The students' paintings will be on show in the hall next week.
example.chinese: 学生们的画作下周将在大厅展出。

application.prompt: The students' paintings will be ___ in the hall next week. A. on show B. in show
application.solution: A。解析：作品“在展出”用 be on show；in show 不是该固定搭配。

grammar: n. 书法家。calligraphy 是书法艺术或字迹，calligraphic 是形容词；复数 calligraphers。
collocations: a skilled calligrapher; Chinese calligrapher; calligrapher's brush; study calligraphy
commonMistake: calligrapher 指写书法的人，calligraphy 指书法本身；句中需要“某人”作主语时不能用 calligraphy。

example.english: The calligrapher wrote each character with a soft brush.
example.chinese: 这位书法家用一支柔软的毛笔写下每个字。

application.prompt: The ___ wrote each character with a brush. A. calligraphy B. calligrapher
application.solution: B。解析：拿笔书写的是 calligrapher（书法家）；calligraphy 是书法艺术或字迹。

grammar: v. 使再现；重现。recreate—recreated—recreated；注意该义读作 /ˌriːkriˈeɪt/，重音在后半部分。
collocations: recreate a scene; recreate the past; recreate an experience; recreate a historical village
commonMistake: recreate（重现）重音在 -ate；不要和名词 recreation 或美式动词 recreate（休闲娱乐，重音不同）混作一个意思。

example.english: The museum used old tools to recreate life in the village a century ago.
example.chinese: 博物馆用旧工具重现了一百年前村庄里的生活。

application.prompt: The team used old photos to ___ the village as it looked a century ago. A. recreate B. recognize
application.solution: A。解析：依据旧照片“重现”过去的村庄应说 recreate；recognize 是认出。

grammar: n. 遗憾；同情；v. 同情。常用 What a pity! 和 It's a pity that...；pity 作动词时可接人作宾语。
collocations: What a pity!; it's a pity that; feel pity for someone; take pity on someone
commonMistake: 感叹“真遗憾”用 What a pity!；what 后接名词短语，不能误写成 How a pity。

example.english: What a pity that the outdoor concert was cancelled by the rain!
example.chinese: 户外音乐会被雨取消了，真遗憾！

application.prompt: ___ that the outdoor concert was cancelled by rain! A. What pity B. What a pity
application.solution: B。解析：户外音乐会因雨取消令人遗憾，感叹句要说 What a pity!，pity 前需要 a。

grammar: adj. 原来的；最初的；独创的；n. 原作。副词 originally；名词 originality。
collocations: the original painting; original idea; original version; originally created
commonMistake: original painting 指原作，originally 是副词“起初”；描述名词 painting 时不能用 originally。

example.english: The original painting is kept in a museum, while copies are sold in the shop.
example.chinese: 原画收藏在博物馆里，而复制品在商店出售。

application.prompt: The artist signed the ___ painting, not the printed copy. A. original B. origin
application.solution: A。解析：被签名的是“原作”绘画，用形容词 original 修饰 painting；origin 是起源。

grammar: n. 版本；说法；译本。可数，常用 a version of sth；动词形式为 vary，含义不同。
collocations: a new version of; the latest version; an English version; a shorter version
commonMistake: version 是“版本”的名词；不要与动词 vary（变化）混淆，也不要漏掉 version 前的冠词。

example.english: I saved a new version of the file after correcting the spelling.
example.chinese: 改正拼写后，我保存了这个文件的新版本。

application.prompt: I saved a new ___ of the file after correcting the spelling. A. vary B. version
application.solution: B。解析：文件修改后保存的是一个新“版本”，需要名词 version；vary 是动词“变化”。

grammar: v. 复制；抄写；n. 复制件；一份。copy—copies（第三人称单数/复数名词）—copied—copied。
collocations: copy a document; copy down the address; a copy of a book; make a copy
commonMistake: copy 变过去式要去 y 加 -ied：copied；第三人称单数写 copies，不能写 copys。

example.english: Please copy the address carefully before you send the letter.
example.chinese: 寄信前请仔细抄下地址。

application.prompt: Please ___ the address carefully before you send the letter. A. copy B. copies
application.solution: A。解析：Please 后用动词原形，故用 copy；copies 是第三人称单数或名词复数。

grammar: adv. 分开；相隔。表示距离时常用 be ... metres apart；take apart 表示拆开。
collocations: five metres apart; grow apart; fall apart; take a machine apart
commonMistake: 表示两者相隔多远时把距离放在 apart 前：The houses are 20 metres apart；不要说 apart 20 metres。

example.english: The two houses stand only a few metres apart.
example.chinese: 这两栋房子只相隔几米。

application.prompt: The two villages lie five kilometres ___. A. parts B. apart
application.solution: B。解析：表示两个地点“相隔五公里”用 five kilometres apart。

grammar: 短语：apart from 可表示“除……之外”（排除），也可表示“除……之外还”（补充），需结合上下文判断。
collocations: apart from the cost; apart from one mistake; apart from that; quite apart from
commonMistake: apart from 有时表示排除、有时表示补充；做阅读题要看前后语义，不能一律只译成“除了……不算”。

example.english: Apart from the cost, the trip was enjoyable from beginning to end.
example.chinese: 除了费用这一点，这趟旅行从头到尾都很愉快。

application.prompt: ___ the cost, the trip was very enjoyable from beginning to end. A. Apart from B. In spite
application.solution: A。解析：此处意为“除了费用之外”，用 apart from；in spite 后还必须接 of。

grammar: n. 邮递员。复数 postmen，属于 man 结尾的复合名词不规则变化；女性可称 postwoman。
collocations: the postman delivered; a local postman; postman and postwoman; postman's bag
commonMistake: postman 的复数是 postmen，不是 postmans；性别不明或泛指职业时也可用 postal worker。

example.english: Our postman rang the bell and handed my father a letter.
example.chinese: 邮递员按响门铃，把一封信交给了我父亲。

application.prompt: Several ___ delivered letters to the houses on our street. A. postmans B. postmen
application.solution: B。解析：several 后用复数；postman 的不规则复数是 postmen。

grammar: n. 小包；小袋；一小包的量。可数，常用 a packet of；英式英语常用 packet，美式语境常见 package。
collocations: a packet of biscuits; a packet of seeds; open a packet; packet lunch
commonMistake: packet 是可数名词，表示“一包”时要有 a/an 或数词；a packet of 后接内容物。

example.english: Mum opened a packet of biscuits and shared them with us.
example.chinese: 妈妈打开一包饼干，和我们一起分享。

application.prompt: Mum opened a ___ of biscuits and shared them with us. A. packet B. slice
application.solution: A。解析：饼干通常装在一包里，a packet of biscuits 表示“一包饼干”。

grammar: n. 粉笔；白垩，通常作不可数名词。单根粉笔说 a piece of chalk；也可作动词表示用粉笔写。
collocations: a piece of chalk; chalk dust; write in chalk; a chalk drawing
commonMistake: chalk 通常不可数，表示一根粉笔用 a piece of chalk；不说 a chalk。

example.english: The teacher wrote the answer on the board with a piece of chalk.
example.chinese: 老师用一支粉笔在黑板上写下了答案。

application.prompt: The teacher wrote on the board with a piece of ___. A. chalky B. chalk
application.solution: B。解析：piece of 后接物质名词 chalk（粉笔）；chalky 是形容词“含粉笔的”。

grammar: n. 老板；上司。可数，复数 bosses；所有格 boss's，如 my boss's office。
collocations: the boss of a company; my new boss; boss's office; work for a boss
commonMistake: boss 以 -s 结尾，复数需加 -es 写 bosses；单数所有格通常加 's：the boss's decision。

example.english: Our boss asked the team to finish the report before lunch.
example.chinese: 我们的老板让团队在午饭前完成报告。

application.prompt: Everyone in the office reports to Ms Lee; she is our ___. A. boss B. customer
application.solution: A。解析：员工向她汇报工作，说明 Ms Lee 是他们的 boss（上司），不是顾客。

grammar: prep. 在……之内；不超过。可接一段时间、范围或边界：within two hours / within the city limits。
collocations: within an hour; within walking distance; within the city; within reach
commonMistake: within two hours 表示“在两小时之内”，不表示“两个小时之后”；若表示之后需用 in two hours。

example.english: Please return the library book within two weeks.
example.chinese: 请在两周内归还图书馆的书。

application.prompt: Please return the library book ___ two weeks. A. between B. within
application.solution: B。解析：归还期限为“两周内”，用 within two weeks；between 通常需说明两端界限。

grammar: adj. 嘈杂的；吵闹的。名词 noise；副词 noisily；比较级 noisier，最高级 noisiest。
collocations: a noisy classroom; noisy neighbours; noisy traffic; noisy children
commonMistake: noisy 是形容词，用来描述地方或人；noise 是名词，可说 make a lot of noise。

example.english: The classroom became noisy when the students returned from lunch.
example.chinese: 学生们午饭后回到教室时，教室变得很吵。

application.prompt: The classroom became so ___ that the teacher paused the lesson. A. noisy B. noise
application.solution: A。解析：became 后作表语需要形容词 noisy；noise 是名词。

grammar: n. 池塘。可数名词，复数 ponds；通常比 lake 小，也可指公园或庭院中的人工水池。
collocations: a garden pond; a small pond; pond water; frogs in a pond
commonMistake: pond 指池塘，拼写中是 d；不要和 pound（英镑或磅）混淆，后者多一个字母 u。

example.english: Frogs were croaking beside the small pond in the garden.
example.chinese: 花园的小池塘旁有青蛙在呱呱叫。

application.prompt: Frogs were croaking beside the small ___ in the garden. A. pound B. pond
application.solution: B。解析：花园里有青蛙的水域是 pond（池塘）；pound 表示“磅/英镑”。

grammar: n. 向日葵。可数名词，复数 sunflowers；常作定语构成 sunflower seeds（葵花籽）。
collocations: a field of sunflowers; sunflower seeds; a sunflower head; grow sunflowers
commonMistake: sunflower 是一个词，不要拆写成 sun flower；表示葵花籽用复数 seeds。

example.english: A tall sunflower stood beside the garden gate.
example.chinese: 花园门旁长着一株高高的向日葵。

application.prompt: The ___ turned its head toward the afternoon sun. A. sunflower B. snowflake
application.solution: A。解析：会朝向阳光生长的是 sunflower（向日葵），不是雪花 snowflake。

grammar: adj. 布满星星的。由 star + -y 构成，常修饰 sky、night 等名词；比较级可用 more starry。
collocations: a starry sky; a starry night; a starry evening; look up at the starry sky
commonMistake: starry 是形容词，表示“星光点点的”；star 是名词，不能直接说 a star sky。

example.english: We lay on the grass and watched the starry sky.
example.chinese: 我们躺在草地上看满天繁星。

application.prompt: We lay on the grass and watched the ___ sky. A. starred B. starry
application.solution: B。解析：修饰 sky 且表示“布满星星的”用形容词 starry。

grammar: n. 激情；热爱；强烈情感。常用 passion for sth；形容词 passionate，常见 be passionate about sth。
collocations: a passion for art; have a passion for music; speak with passion; passionate about nature
commonMistake: 名词 passion 后常接 for：a passion for painting；形容词 passionate 后常接 about：passionate about painting。

example.english: Maya speaks about wildlife with such passion that everyone listens.
example.chinese: 玛雅谈起野生动物时充满热情，大家都会认真听。

application.prompt: Maya speaks about wildlife with such ___ that everyone listens. A. passion B. passionate
application.solution: A。解析：such 后此处需要名词 passion；passionate 是形容词，不能直接放在 such 后。
